user.title: Alert condition
user.description: Watch an exact state, or set one numeric problem threshold. Numeric thresholds use the source entity's units; no unit conversion is performed. For compound conditions, select a Template binary sensor helper.

data_description.state: Underlying state string, such as on or open. Ignored when a numeric problem threshold is set.
data_description.numeric_below: Optional. Start when the value is strictly below this number. Leave both problem thresholds empty to match the state instead.
data_description.numeric_above: Optional. Start when the value is strictly above this number. Choose only one problem threshold.
data_description.numeric_recover_above: Optional. Keep the incident active until strictly above this value. Must be at least the problem-below threshold.
data_description.numeric_recover_below: Optional. Keep the incident active until strictly below this value. Must be at most the problem-above threshold.
data_description.numeric_unit: Exact unit attribute, for example %, °C, or °F. A missing or different unit suspends evaluation. Empty accepts the source's current units.

timing.title: Reminder timing and controls
timing.description: Add intervals in order. The last interval repeats indefinitely. Acknowledgement silences this incident; it does not disable the alert or reset its schedule.

data.evaluate_on_start: Evaluate the existing condition on startup
data.restore_state: Restore incidents after restart or reload

data_description.intervals: One row gives a fixed interval. For example, 15, 30, 60 uses those delays in sequence, then repeats every 60 minutes. Minimum 0.016 minutes.
data_description.skip_first: When enabled, wait the first interval before notifying. Otherwise notify immediately when the problem begins.
data_description.evaluate_on_start: Start a new incident if the source already matches when the integration loads. Off preserves built-in Alert startup behavior. Restoring a saved incident takes precedence.
data_description.restore_state: Save acknowledgement, snooze, incident identity and deadlines. After source readiness, send at most one overdue reminder and resume the schedule. Off starts fresh after reload.
data_description.activation_delay: Require the problem to remain true for this long before creating an incident. Zero starts immediately. The first repeat interval begins after this delay.
data_description.recovery_delay: Require the recovery condition to remain true for this long before resolving. Reminders continue during this delay.
data_description.unavailable_policy: Resolve treats a nonmatching unknown/unavailable state as clear. Suspend preserves the incident and pauses reminders until usable data returns. Invalid numeric values always suspend.
data_description.enable_snooze: Allow the Snooze button and action. Snooze is separate from acknowledgement; reminders continue advancing silently.
data_description.snooze_minutes: Used by the device and phone buttons, and by the snooze action when no duration is supplied. Maximum one week.
data_description.action_buttons: Add incident-specific Acknowledge, Snooze, and Open alert controls to direct mobile_app notify actions. Test and resolution messages have no generated controls. Automatic controls replace any actions in extra data for these destinations.

notifications.title: Notification destinations
notifications.description: Select any number of destinations, or leave both lists empty for status only. Set up notification providers first. A missing destination is reported at dispatch and retried at the next reminder.

data_description.notifiers: Choose an action such as mobile_app_my_phone or persistent_notification. You can also enter a missing action name. Use a notify group for provider-specific top-level targets.
data_description.notify_entities: Uses notify.send_message. Home Assistant 2026.9.2 supports message and title only for these targets. Use a legacy action if you need extra data, tags, or action buttons.

messages.title: Notification content
messages.description: Enter plain text or Home Assistant templates. Leave message blank to use the alert name. A resolution notification requires an earlier alert attempt, including when the incident was subsequently acknowledged.

data_description.message: Rendered again for each notification. The alert name itself is literal text.
data_description.title: Optional, rendered for alert and resolution notifications.
data_description.done_message: Optional. For compatible Companion actions, use clear_notification with a stable tag in extra data to clear the notification.
data_description.data: Optional YAML mapping passed unchanged under the notifier data key. For example: tag: garage-door. Templates inside this mapping are not evaluated. Notify entities do not accept this field.

review.title: Review alert

error.invalid_repeat: Add at least one finite interval of at least 0.016 minutes that fits a valid notification date.
error.invalid_template: Enter valid Home Assistant template syntax.
error.invalid_destination: Use a specific notify action name or a notify entity. notify.notify and notify.send_message are not legacy destination names.
error.invalid_data: Extra data must be a YAML mapping, not a list or text.
error.entity_data_unsupported: Notify entities do not accept extra data in Home Assistant 2026.9.2. Clear this field, or choose only legacy notify actions.
error.invalid_duration: Enter a finite nonnegative delay that fits a valid date. Snooze must be greater than zero and at most 10080 minutes.
error.incompatible_thresholds: Choose one problem threshold and its corresponding recovery threshold. Recovery must be at or beyond the problem threshold in the recovery direction.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Silence reminders for the current incident until it resolves. Targets Modern Alerts status sensors.

unacknowledge.name: Resume reminders
unacknowledge.description: Clear acknowledgement and snooze. Resume on the existing reminder schedule without sending immediately.

turn_off.name: Acknowledge (turn off)
turn_off.description: Alias for acknowledge. Does not disable condition monitoring.

turn_on.name: Resume (turn on)
turn_on.description: Alias for unacknowledge. Does not force the problem to become active.

toggle.name: Toggle acknowledgement
toggle.description: Toggle acknowledgement of the selected alert.

test_notification.name: Test notification
test_notification.description: Send the current alert message explicitly, without changing incident or resolution eligibility.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Silence reminders temporarily without clearing acknowledgement. Omit minutes to use the alert default.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Duration greater than zero and at most 10080 minutes.

cancel_snooze.name: Cancel snooze
cancel_snooze.description: End temporary silence without clearing acknowledgement or changing the reminder schedule.
